d:
The "Am I Blue II" porn comic from artist SteadxKnight, centered around the characters Aqua and Terra from the Kingdom Hearts videogame series.

The gallery is split in three parts, the first is the "Golden and Blue" main comic, the second is a series of various separate artworks (mostly about Aqua and Terra but some also with other characters from other series), and the third part is a series of sketches and unfinished artworks.
